cases.title: Frontend Design
cases.verificationGoal: Verify the exact current artifact, its SKILL.md, repository status, and first-party provenance.

cases.title: Figma Design to Code
cases.verificationGoal: Treat the missing deep link as a locator failure. Search the same current repository for the exact or renamed artifact and verify its SKILL.md.

cases.title: Figma Implement Design
cases.verificationGoal: Determine whether the old artifact was relocated, deprecated, renamed, or replaced. Follow first-party migration guidance, identify the current successor if supported, and compare its scope instead of treating file existence as current maintenance.

cases.title: Retired Phantom Skill
cases.verificationGoal: Verify that no exact artifact exists and do not invent a successor merely because the repository points to a newer ecosystem repository.

cases.title: Figma Workflow
cases.verificationGoal: Check whether one exact current successor can be proven. Multiple related Figma skills without artifact-level identity evidence must remain ambiguous.

cases.title: Figma Plugin Root
cases.verificationGoal: Determine whether this exact directory is itself a portable skill. A plugin container with several child skills must not be verified as one skill unless an exact SKILL.md supports that identity.
